result:
All 14 queries ran against their input files and gave sensible answers. I checked the answers only by eye, not against independent expected values.

- **U1:** gave `["adam" "Bob" "Zoe"]`.
- **U2:** gave `69.93`.
- **U5:** the top 3 come out as abe, kim and lee, each with 2. I didn't check how ties and further assignees fall beyond those three.
- **U7:** the average GET duration is `94`.
- **U12:** gave `{u1: logout, u2: purchase, u3: login}`.
- **U14:** gave a count of 6 and longest `["elderberry" "banana"]`.

U5 and U8 return keyword-derived values that print as plain strings in the output. I did not convert them with `keyword`, since the printed form already matches the requested strings.

U1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
U2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
U3: filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)
U4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
U5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:assignee /0 :count /1}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3
U6: map ~(at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort
U7: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | take (count | sub 2) | parseJson) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
U8: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:p /0 :c /1}) | sort ~([(/c | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p | keyword)
U9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | map ~(split "," | {:name /0 :cat (/1 | lower) :price /2 :stock /3}) | filter ~(/price | ne "") | map ~({:cat /cat :price (/price | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/cat) | map ~(map ~(/price) | avg | mul 100 | round | div 100)
U10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | map ~(split "," | {:name /0 :price /2 :stock /3}) | filter ~(/price | ne "") | map ~({:name /name :price (/price | parseJson) :stock (/stock | parseJson)}) | filter ~(/stock | ne 0) | sort ~([(/price | desc) /name]) | take 3 | map ~(/name)
U11: :d /defaults | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :s /1}) | filter ~(/s | at :enabled | coalesce (d | /enabled) | ne false) | map ~({:name /name :port (/s | at :port | coalesce (d | /port))}) | sort ~(/name)
U12: groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(sort ~(/ts | desc) | first | /type)
U13: lines | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | ne true) | map ~(split "|" | map ~(trim)) | filter ~(/2 | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | upper) | sort | join ","
U14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","fig","Elderberry","cherry","Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | {:count count :longest (sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | take 2)}
